Hero.title: From user-focused interfaces to end-to-end products
Hero.p1: I'm Buğrahan Umay Şafak, Umay for short. I'm a software engineer who builds fast, accessible and maintainable products with modern web technologies.
Hero.p2: From June 2024 to July 2025, I worked remotely as a full-time Frontend Developer at getClinic, where I designed the Next.js-based frontend architecture for the company's backoffice and portal systems. Working closely with backend developers in an Agile/Scrum team, and the discipline of keeping Lighthouse scores above 95, taught me a lot.
Hero.p3: Today I work freelance, building websites and admin panels for clients in industries such as legal, spa & wellness and education. On these projects I handle everything on my own, from frontend to backend and from server setup to launch.
